versions.content: CanTrcv driver shall use the following APIs provided by ICU driver, to enable and disable the wakeup event notification: - Icu_EnableNotification - Icu_DisableNotification CanTrcv driver shall enable/disable ICU channels only if reference is configured for the parameter CanTrcvIcuChannelRef .
